# Practice show site: pack source

A made-up source for a practice show site, and the text the pack loads word for word. Every person, event, page and post in it is a sample. Two group names are real names chosen for the show site; each has one line saying its page is a sample, and nothing else in the pack is about them.

## People

- tamsin_reyes (Tamsin Reyes): Sample member. Looks after the sample events in the Commons.
- idris_calloway (Idris Calloway): Sample member. Organizes the sample events of the first city group.
- priya_vance (Priya Vance): Sample member. Organizes the sample events of the second city group.
- noor_haddix (Noor Haddix): Sample member. Likes the newcomers' coffee best.
- felix_brandt (Felix Brandt): Sample member. Goes to the build nights in both groups.
- jonah_wilder (Jonah Wilder): Sample member. New to the site.
- lena_ostrova (Lena Ostrova): Sample member. Runs the sample study group.
- caleb_fenwick (Caleb Fenwick): Sample member. Helps new members find their way around.

## Groups

### Commons

Sample group: the shared space for everyone on this practice site. Every event, page and member on this site is a made-up sample.

### Denver Blockchain

Sample practice page on this demo site: its events, pages and members are made up, not this group's own.

### Boulder Blockchain

Sample practice page on this demo site: its events, pages and members are made up, not this group's own.

## Pages

### Sample: how our meetups usually run

In the group Denver Blockchain, open to everyone.

Sample page, made up for this practice site. Meetups start with ten minutes of introductions. Newcomers are paired with someone who has been before. We finish by choosing the next event together.

### Sample: questions people ask before coming

In the group Boulder Blockchain, open to everyone.

Sample page, made up for this practice site. You need nothing before you come. The sample events are free. You are welcome to bring a friend.

### Sample: how events work on this site

In the group Commons, open to everyone.

Sample page, made up for this practice site. Every group lists its events on its own events tab, and the events page shows the events of all groups together. Say you are going on an event page and the organizer sees you on the list.

### Sample: notes for members of this group

In the group Denver Blockchain, for members of the group only.

Sample page, made up for this practice site. Notes for members only: who brings the sign-in sheet and who locks up after a meetup.
